tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background for every admin route. Cards sit directly on it with a border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground, table header rows, tinted panels inside cards (opener box, brief cards).

tokens.name: bg-track
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, fit chip, progress bar track, muted status badge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: cards, table rows, inputs, sidebar edge, top bar.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed borders only: add-filter buttons, empty add cards, unset brief sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, page titles, dark primary buttons, the worth-a-call card ground, floating action bar ground. 15.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy in quotes and transcripts. Also the ring track on ink grounds.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Secondary button labels, table cell text that is not the primary cell, mono fit chip text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items, dashed-button labels, Birdsong turns in a transcript.

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Field labels, stat labels, second lines in staggered rows, timestamps. 4.8:1 on bg: the lightest text allowed at 12px.

tokens.name: muted-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders, keyboard hints, unassigned state, disabled counts. Never for text that must be read; 3:1 only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary buttons, links in card headers, live dots, score 9 chip ground, active tab underline, progress fill. 5.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: accent-weak
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent text: score 7 and 8 chips, In HubSpot badge, live count pill, active filter chip.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Brand bars in the wordmark and logo tile, avatar ground, the ring and Triage button on the ink card. Only on ink grounds.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Second segment of a stacked progress bar (in progress after completed).

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: Dot for New leads and unworked attention items.

tokens.name: status-new-bg
tokens.usage: New badge ground.

tokens.name: status-new-text
tokens.usage: New badge text. 7.6:1 on status-new-bg.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Dot and bar fill for a question that is underperforming, Meeting badge dot.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Callout ground for interview quality warnings and failed pushes.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: Border of the warn callout.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text and solid button inside a warn callout. 6.7:1 on warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn-bg-badge
tokens.usage: Meeting booked badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Dot only: failed HubSpot push, integration needing attention. Never a fill.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink, accent and warn-text grounds.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the ink card. 4.6:1 on ink.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value, segmented control padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, dot to label, chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cells in a compact grid, callout padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table column gap, card inner padding on the short side, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on the long side, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on dense pages (study detail).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding, gap between page sections on Home.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page horizontal padding inside main.

tokens.name: shell-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width. Fixed.

tokens.name: shell-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height on every page.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of every button and input in a top bar or filter row.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Height of a staggered two-line table row. 42px for the header row, 54px for single-line rows.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Score and fit chips, status badges, nav items, small buttons inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, filter chips, segmented control track.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, stat rows, panels.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: The worth-a-call card and other single-purpose hero cards on Home.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only the floating action bar and its buttons. Nothing else is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-input
tokens.usage: The study launcher input and the chat input. Cards do not get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-active-nav
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item and active segmented tab: a ring plus a hairline lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating action bar only.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every enter and grow animation.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Card fade-up on page load, staggered by 80ms per card.

tokens.name: duration-count
tokens.usage: Number count-up and the ring draw on the worth-a-call card.

tokens.name: duration-wave
tokens.usage: Waveform bar breathing loop while an interview is live.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: Live dot ring pulse loop.
